issuer: the Public Services Agency (Agenția Servicii Publice, ASP)
note: Read 2026-10-30. Government Decision No. 181 of 23 March 2022 approving the Regulation on the examination procedure for obtaining the right to drive, the issue and validity of the driving licence (the text the Public Services Agency publishes, as amended to 15 April 2022; later amendments weren't read): point 19(1)(b), an applicant for category B must be 18; point 41, a licence is issued to those who have passed the examinations; point 44, the licence is issued for 10 years unless restrictions limit it; point 45, from 65 the holder's medical fitness is confirmed every three years (not held). The ASP's page for issuing, exchanging or restoring a driving licence (saved in wave 9 the same day): 440 lei in 20 working days, the standard term, held (faster terms cost 880 to 2,640 lei; some holders are exempt). The theory and practical tests' fees aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's; exchanges weren't read into a list.
